title: Rigged dog with motion matching in Unreal Engine 5.9
author: vimmerio
selftext:
Digital double of my own dog, this week she started walking around in Unreal Engine 5.9! This came from a need to have a dog for the farm game - that was not a german shepard I had from Fab - so what better idea is set out to build and bring in your own in doggy! 

What went into it: 

🦴 A custom quadruped rig with a modular Control Rig, built to bake dog motion capture cleanly, 3D modeling from reference photos. 

🎥What you are seing are 51 dog mocap takes (about 40 minutes) retargeted onto the Conrtol rig 

🧠 Motion matching (PoseSearch) set up the way Epic's Game Animation Sample does it, adapted from two legs to four 

🐾 Foot locking and leg IK on all four paws, so the feet stay planted instead of sliding Working on cleaner walk cycles, smoother turns, and a bit more of Alcantara's personality :)
